title: Colorado Man Kills His Wife After Catfishing Her for Months
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation surrounding a Colorado man’s elaborate catfish scheme that ended in his wife’s demise. Daniel Krug’s wife, Kristil Krug, 44, was found beaten and stabbed to death in the couple’s home. Months prior, Kristil was seemingly being stalked through fake phone numbers, email addresses, and more by someone who appeared to be her ex-boyfriend. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
